claim: Multi-step forms increase conversion by 30-40% compared to single-step forms
evidence_quote: Multi-step forms reduce perceived friction and maintain engagement through progressive commitment, resulting in 30-40% higher conversion rates

claim: Each second of load time beyond 3 seconds reduces conversion by approximately 7%
evidence_quote: Page load time directly impacts conversion: 1s=100%, 2s=93%, 3s=86%, 4s=79%, 5s=72%, showing ~7% drop per second

claim: Authority signals provide 25-40% conversion lift in medical contexts
evidence_quote: Physician credentials, experience, and certifications are the strongest trust signals for medical services, increasing conversion by 25-40%

claim: Exit-intent popups recover 5-15% of abandoning visitors
evidence_quote: Exit-intent technology can recover 5-15% of visitors who would otherwise leave without converting

claim: Retargeting converts 2-5x better than cold traffic
evidence_quote: Retargeted visitors who have previously visited a landing page convert at 2-5x the rate of cold traffic

claim: FDA prohibits outcome guarantees in medical advertising
evidence_quote: Medical advertising must be truthful and not misleading; guaranteed outcomes or cure claims are prohibited

claim: HIPAA requires patient consent for testimonials
evidence_quote: Use of protected health information including patient testimonials requires written authorization under HIPAA Privacy Rule

claim: E-E-A-T is critical for medical content ranking
evidence_quote: Medical content is YMYL (Your Money Your Life) and requires demonstrable Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness

claim: Core Web Vitals target: LCP <2.5s, FID <100ms, CLS <0.1
evidence_quote: Google Core Web Vitals thresholds: Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5 seconds, First Input Delay under 100 milliseconds, Cumulative Layout Shift under 0.1

claim: 152-FZ requires explicit consent for personal data collection in Russia
evidence_quote: Federal Law 152-FZ mandates explicit consent before collecting personal data of Russian citizens, with data localization requirements

claim: Medical landing pages target 5-15% conversion vs 2-5% for blog content
evidence_quote: Conversion-focused landing pages for medical services achieve 5-15% conversion rates, approximately 3x higher than informational blog content at 2-5%

claim: 50%+ of healthcare searches occur on mobile devices
evidence_quote: Mobile devices account for 60-70% of healthcare-related searches, making mobile optimization critical for conversion

claim: Each additional form field reduces conversion by 5-10%
evidence_quote: Form field optimization research shows each additional required field reduces conversion by approximately 5-10%

claim: Automated CRM follow-up increases conversion by 20-30%
evidence_quote: Real-time CRM integration with automated follow-up sequences increases lead-to-patient conversion by 20-30%

claim: AIDA framework achieves 5-8% conversion for diagnostic services
evidence_quote: AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) framework is most effective for diagnostic and preventive medical services, achieving 5-8% conversion rates
